top_issues: Legend text under headline balance mixes four categories on two wrapped lines with small 12px muted fonts, impairing fast triage between secured and promised funds.
Educational card 'Two colours, one rule' occupies prime thumb-reach area above the fold on mobile.
Spendable now vs can receive has low optical contrast against dark card background.
fixes: Group breakdown into a clean 2x2 numeric grid with prominent values and explicit status chips.
Make the educational tip card dismissible into an unobtrusive inline help badge.
Increase font weight and brightness on '$175.00' and '$0.50' capacity labels.

top_issues: Account slider bar in H1 account card has tiny tick mark indicators that lack clear numerical endpoints.
Timestamp format '05:33' in recent transactions lacks calendar date or relative indicator (e.g. Today / 2m ago).
Dual colored bar underneath 'Received' and 'Sent' rows is visually disconnected from the transaction amount on the right.
fixes: Add explicit min/max scale labels directly above the H1 capacity bar.
Show 'Today, 05:33' or relative timestamp for immediate clarity on recent items.
Anchor the green/violet assurance pill directly to the amount text on the right column.

top_issues: Hex recipient address underneath 'H2' is truncated into a dense wall of unreadable monospace text.
Fee shown as 'under 0.01 USDC' lacks exact breakdown of routing margin versus network cost.
The small purple/green balance meter inside the input card feels cramped and risks misinterpretation as an input slider.
fixes: Replace raw hex string with verified entity badge and standard truncated checksum format.
Display exact satoshi/wei equivalent fee on tap or secondary line.
Label balance meter explicitly with 'Available headroom: $150.00'.

top_issues: Route comparison cards show micro-fees (0.000050 vs 0.000075) with identical visual weight, making decision criteria unclear.
Primary action button 'Pay 25.00 USDC' sits close to route cards without explicit final confirmation of total debited.
Route hops (You -> H1 -> H2) use subtle badge styling that lacks latency or counterparty status.
fixes: Highlight recommended route with a 'Fastest / Lowest Fee' pill tag.
Include total with fee in the CTA: 'Pay 25.000050 USDC'.
Add ping/health dots next to intermediate hubs H1 and H3.

top_issues: Modal sheet header obscures background balance without complete backdrop blur or readable context.
Execution latency 'in 9 s' is colored bright green alongside 'PAID', blurring settlement status with speed metric.
Proof hash is truncated to '0x00109fe5...6bec' with no one-tap full verification drawer.
fixes: Increase background scrim opacity to 75% for sharper focus on the modal receipt.
Keep status 'Settled' green, but render 'in 9 s' in neutral tertiary gray.
Add tap-to-expand or copy tooltip directly on the proof hash line.

top_issues: Four horizontal action buttons at bottom ('Copy receipt', 'Download', 'Print / PDF', 'Done') crowd touch targets on narrower screens.
Background content peek at top shows cut-off balance and account info, causing visual noise.
'Verified by your runtime' text lacks a link to inspecting the local signature verification log.
fixes: Consolidate 'Download' and 'Print / PDF' into an export icon menu, leaving 'Done' full width or prominent.
Snap sheet to full height or ensure clean solid top border.
Make 'Verified by your runtime' an interactive sheet trigger showing local state tree transition.

'0.50 capacity via H1' notice is placed in low-contrast caption text, hiding inbound liquidity limits from receiver.
Input value '0.00' looks active but does not indicate whether specifying an amount modifies the QR code live.

Prominently warn 'Max instant receipt: $0.50 without opening credit' with an amber indicator.
Add caption: 'QR updates automatically as you type amount'.

top_issues: Entity ID raw hash '0x601dfa70...997f23' provides zero human-readable reassurance for counterparty verification.
Secondary options ('Print / PDF', 'Other ways to share') lack button affordance and blend into background.
Descriptive copy 'Anyone with an account route to you...' is wordy for mobile utility.
fixes: Add a prominent one-tap 'Copy ID' button next to the Entity hash.
Convert 'Print / PDF' and 'Share' into icon secondary buttons with distinct borders.
Condense explanatory body text to one concise sentence.

top_issues: Prepare to receive slider card introduces high cognitive overhead with dual concepts: 'Collateral' vs 'New credit'.

Lot rounding detail '0.000004 USDC stays with you' clutters standard swap metadata.
fixes: Add plain-English tooltip: 'Hub provides credit vs locks backing tokens'.

fixes: Add file format and size badge to button: 'Save evidence bundle (ZIP · 14 KB)'.
Highlight '24h challenge window' with a shield badge.

overall.verdict: The xln mobile-dark interface achieves industry-leading transparency into bilateral credit, enforceable on-chain collateral, and cryptographic runtime state. However, it frequently overloads mainstream users with raw protocol mechanics, mathematical formulas, and dense text where simple visual status indicators and guided flows are needed.
priority_fixes: Replace protocol math formulas (e.g. collateral tariffs, tick sizes, bps) with pre-computed fiat and token figures.
Reorganize the top of Home and Sovereignty screens to cleanly separate instant spendable cash from counterparty exposure.
Streamline cross-chain and collateral setup in Swap into a sequential multi-step progress wizard rather than stacked conflicting cards.
Consolidate repetitive technical diagnostics (Runtime ID, Frame numbers, hex addresses) into expandable inspection drawers.
Redesign receipt and activity export actions to prioritize one-tap compliance reporting and plain-English proof sharing.
